title: HB 1493 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 2; Title 4; Title 8 and Section 55-50-336, relative to election-related communications.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) Sec.1, new section in Title 2 Ch.1
(quote) (1) That state-issued photo identification cards for purposes of voting may be obtained free of charge from the Tennessee department of safety; (2) The manner in which to apply for and receive the identification card; (3) The information that an applicant needs to apply for the identification card; and (4) The following prominently displayed statement: A STATE-ISSUED PHOTO IDENTIFICATION CARD MAY BE USED FOR VOTING PURPOSES, AS AUTHORIZED BY TENNESSEE CODE ANNOTATED, SECTION 2-7-112(c)
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Sec.1(a)-(b): the secretary of state and each county election commission must put the free-ID information above in every 'election-related communication' sent to one or more state residents; (b) defines the term broadly (flyers, signs, ads, calls, emails, social media, texts).
(other) Sec.2: effective on becoming law.
(other) The title also names Title 4, Title 8 and Section 55-50-336, but the saved text has no section amending them.
(other) version: Draft 2673493 (only version saved): carries slot b (free state photo ID notice requirement).
(other) note: Last action 2023-02-15: failed in the House Elections and Campaign Finance Subcommittee of Local Government. Skeleton lists no roll call for it. Companion SB 1017 has identical operative text.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
